definitions.explanation: An open area of land covered with grass or wildflowers, typically uncultivated. Evokes a natural, peaceful setting.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{野原|のはら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野原|のはら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}いていた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers were blooming all across the spring meadow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{野原|のはら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝転|ねころ}んで→寝転ぶ：04643_nekorobu⟧、⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like lying down in a wide meadow and watching the clouds drift by.

notes:
{野原|のはら} is a compound of ⟦{野|の}→野：03535_no⟧ (field, wild) and {原|はら} (plain, field). It refers to a natural, uncultivated open area and carries a pleasant, pastoral connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{野原|のはら} (a wide meadow)
- {野原|のはら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play in the field)
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧{野原|のはら} (a flower-covered meadow)
- {野原|のはら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧ (to run around in the field)

Distinct from ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (cultivated field, farm field) and ⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧/⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ (rice paddy). {野原|のはら} specifically implies a natural, unfarmed area. Often appears in children's stories and nostalgic descriptions of rural life.
